In [[188 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kibh Jeen]] led [[Kibh Jeen's army|his pirate army]] in '''an attack''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]], in what was the opening battle of the [[Dark Jedi Conflict]]. Jeen's [[Army/Legends|army]] devastated Genarius' floating [[City/Legends|cites]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] thousands of people and destroying hundreds of homes.
